finding.result: The pinned Cargo test constructs a project that depends on not_cached_dep=1.2.5 and immediately runs `cargo check --offline`; it does not publish or pre-cache that package in the test setup. Cargo therefore fails during dependency resolution with a no-matching-package/index error. In the same pinned official file, tests where registry metadata is known but a crate payload is unavailable fail instead at the download stage with an explicit failed-to-download/offline HTTP error. Within this exact source scope, the not_cached_dep case is therefore an index/registry-resolution prerequisite failure, not evidence of a missing crate archive.
finding.local_prerequisite: A locally available registry/index view containing resolvable metadata for the requested dependency/version (or equivalent vendored/local source metadata) must exist before offline resolution can proceed to any crate-archive availability check.
finding.fixture_note: The specific test itself creates no not_cached_dep package fixture before the offline command, so the local test registry/index has no usable entry for this dependency in the observed setup. This classifies the observed failure stage; it does not prove whether an identically named/versioned package exists on the real public registry outside the pinned test harness.

verified_scope: Pinned rust-lang/cargo commit 8814ead110e36ed8fdcf1fdd4009baf82bd78523, tests/testsuite/offline.rs: cargo_compile_offline_not_try_update setup/command/error, with same-file offline missing-payload tests used only as stage-discriminating controls.
not_verified_scope: Real crates.io package existence for not_cached_dep, actual local Cargo cache contents outside the test harness, network syscall absence, end-to-end execution inside Chat, vendoring behavior, arbitrary Cargo versions, or complete richer-mode parity.
scope_guard: Do not generalize this test into a claim that --offline never needs crate archives or that all no-matching-package errors mean the package is globally nonexistent. The supported claim is only that this pinned test fails before archive download because locally resolvable registry/index metadata is absent in its setup.

hard_gate_assessment.positive_evidence_scope: Official source-level failure-stage classification only; no end-to-end Chat parity claim.
